scope.target_name: Native Codex subagent routing, principal workflow routing and WSL/Desktop portable parity

executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Canonical routing and sync ownership are inconsistent with current root preference
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Persist root choice to the canonical policy before installing or syncing

packaged_ecc_profiles.status: Markdown package profiles; ECC Codex manifest has no agents entry. Not counted as current native Codex roles.

findings.title: Canonical root routing contradicts current root settings
findings.mechanism: Both homes configure gpt-6.1-sol/max, but canonical and installed policy still specify gpt-6-astra/xhigh. Full installer candidate changes exactly model and model_reasoning_effort.
findings.root_cause: Manual/runtime root preference was not persisted to the canonical routing policy.
findings.recommended_fix: Set canonical root to gpt-6.1-sol/max before installation; regenerate managed instructions and verify both homes.

findings.title: Existing Desktop sync check fails before deployment
findings.mechanism: Read-only --check returns Planned config failed to synchronize [agents]. In-memory candidate omits vacancy_researcher registration. Family extraction assumes contiguous tables, while the source [agents] defaults and registrations are separated by other table families.
findings.root_cause: Unversioned helper uses first contiguous family span instead of all TOML family members.
findings.recommended_fix: Consolidate synchronization in a tracked installer, support separated tables, preserve unmanaged settings, and require dry-run plus fixture verification before live deployment.

findings.title: Auxiliary roles still pin the previous Sol model
findings.mechanism: 13 managed auxiliary files and both defaults use gpt-6-sol/medium. Updating only defaults cannot override explicit per-role model fields.
findings.recommended_fix: Change the canonical class to gpt-6.1-sol/medium and regenerate every explicit auxiliary role.

findings.title: Vacancy researcher is outside managed parity and Git coverage
findings.mechanism: WSL has vacancy_researcher on gpt-5.6-luna/max. Desktop has neither its file nor registration. Matching local source is ignored by resume_hh .gitignore and is not tracked.
findings.root_cause: Specialist role has a separate local-only source outside the 19-role canonical installer.
findings.recommended_fix: Choose one versioned owning template for this role, preserve its research/privacy boundaries, route to Sol 6.1/Medium and include file plus registration in both homes.

findings.title: Project roles can retain or bypass global routing
findings.mechanism: ECC registers three GPT-5.4 role files. CRM_Dima and its worktree pin ten roles to High. ai_mrketing_agentci has same-name local reviewer/explorer/researcher/worker files with no model, effort or sandbox fields; if selected, they inherit defaults rather than the explicit global role route. Effective project loading was not tested.
findings.root_cause: Multiple project role authorities exist without explicit routing reconciliation.
findings.recommended_fix: Reconcile project roles in their own repositories; retain narrow Sol reviews while reserving the global Astra acceptor for required whole-outcome acceptance.

findings.title: Desktop compatibility settings conflict with leaf-only parity
findings.mechanism: WSL max_depth=1; Desktop max_depth=2 and features.multi_agent_v2.enabled=false. Desktop comments identify codex-chatgpt-web Compatibility V1 as owner. Runtime need and currently active ownership are unverified.
findings.root_cause: Separate Desktop compatibility workflow owns overlapping orchestration fields.
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve compatibility ownership before changing these fields; native Codex baseline should remain leaf-only. Share portable model/role policy, not entire machine-specific configuration.

findings.title: Per-role High is not supported by current route renderer
findings.mechanism: role_route returns the complete class route. An in-memory worker effort=high field still resolves medium. load_policy does not reject that unsupported role field.
findings.root_cause: Only class-wide routes are implemented and per-role unknown keys are not validated.
findings.recommended_fix: For the recommended selective-High variant, add explicit validated effort overrides within auxiliary roles and render those exceptions in the generated policy; test unknown-key rejection.

findings.title: Some optional ECC skills prescribe fixed agent counts and gates
findings.mechanism: orch-pipeline says each phase delegates and names package agent roles absent from the current native role catalog. dev-team and council prescribe four and three agents. These are static instruction findings; invocation frequency and added cost were not measured.
findings.source_layer: System prompt and hidden agent layers
findings.root_cause: Harness-specific workflow recipes are not fully adapted to the active root-first Codex policy.
findings.recommended_fix: Use principal managed workflows by default; preserve opt-in multi-voice skills and adapt unsupported named package roles via applicable native Sol roles. Edit owned source, not plugin cache.

findings.title: Parser-refactor backend role contains a stale project path
findings.mechanism: The two CRM role sets differ only in the backend worker instructions; the refactor copy names /home/artem/CRM_Dima.
findings.root_cause: Worktree-specific instruction copy retained a historical absolute path.
findings.recommended_fix: Use the assigned repository root and preserve worktree ownership when reconciling the role.

verification.desktop_policy_blocks: All four managed blocks have equal content between homes; Desktop exact-file drift is block ordering around an unmanaged browser note, not differing managed meaning.

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Adopt variant A or B and canonicalize root/default/acceptance routes
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Prevent reinstallation from reverting root preference

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Implement validated per-role effort overrides only for variant B
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Current renderer silently ignores this proposal
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Selected High roles are actually generated and visible in policy

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Version the vacancy role and reconcile project overrides
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Global default alone does not cover all audited definitions
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: No untracked Luna role or unintentional GPT-5.4 override

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Repair and version synchronization and settle compatibility ownership
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Current helper fails preflight and owns overlapping Desktop fields
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Safe repeatable file/registration parity with machine-specific settings preserved

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Validate temporary homes, install with backups, verify WSL/Desktop and fresh native sessions
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Static equality cannot prove the running Desktop reloaded configuration
ordered_fix_plan.expected_effect: Verified file parity plus separate bounded runtime evidence
